title: Evidence Package
description: Schema for the canonical evidence package envelope emitted by compose-dashboard. The framework's central architectural claim is that this JSON envelope IS the product; markdown reports, HTML dashboards, PowerPoint decks, and decision memos are all *renderings* of an instance of this schema. See plan § Target Dashboard Architecture § Evidence package IS the product (A3) and § compose-dashboard behavioral spec (B1) for the runtime semantics that produce instances. This schema validates the runtime-emitted artifact; it does NOT validate authoring surfaces (those live in card.schema.json and dashboard_spec.schema.json).

package_id.description: Stable identifier for this specific evidence package emission. Convention: ep-{target}-{indication}-{release_pin}-{data_mode}-{seq}.

framework_version.description: Semver of the framework that emitted this package. Iter-1 ships 2.0.0.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of emission. Non-deterministic; excluded from card-invariance equality checks.

generated_by.description: Skill identifier + git_sha that emitted this package (e.g., 'skills/compose-dashboard@a1b2c3d').

context.description: The (target, indication, scope, subgroup_spec) binding this package was emitted for.

subgroup_spec.description: Either a list of subgroup_ids, the string 'all', or null.

governance.description: Governance metadata: data mode, release pin, lockfile reference, concurrence record reference, validation summary. The block downstream renderers consult to decide whether to emit into a nomination-grade artifact.

data_mode.description: Must match data_mode.enum.yaml; inlined for standalone validation.

resolved_release_digest.description: Governance enrichment (2026-08-12): sha256(sorted input_manifest_ids)[:16] — the run's DATA FINGERPRINT across every family it read. Changes when the underlying releases change, so it distinguishes runs across catalog releases even when release_pin is 'unpinned' (the eval-ledger cross-release trend keys on it).

resolved_releases.description: Governance enrichment: per data-family, the manifests this run USED, the current catalog HEAD (via catalog_query.resolve_release), and an is_stale drift flag (True = the run read a superseded release). Best-effort; a family may carry resolution_error + head:null.

lockfile_ref.description: Relative path to lockfile.yaml within the package directory.

concurrence.description: Optional concurrence-record reference. Absent for exploratory-mode packages or for packages not yet reviewed.

dashboard_spec_ref.description: Reference to the dashboard_spec used to compose this package (e.g., 'target-contracts/dashboards/target-in-indication.dashboard_spec.yaml@<git_sha>').

cards.description: Per-card outputs. Each entry is ONE of: (1) a present-and-validated card (card_present — summary, interpretation_call, provenance); (2) an applies_when exclusion stub (card_excluded — a structured predicate reason); (3) an availability stub (card_unavailable — the card produced no usable signal, carrying a typed availability_state that says WHY: not_wired / data_blocked / read_error / insufficient). card_unavailable replaces the historical silent drop-to-n_cards_failed: an unwired or data-blocked card is now a first-class, reasoned absence a consumer can key on, not an opaque integer. Validation-FAILED cards (method exception / schema violation) still do NOT appear here — they are surfaced only in validation_report.json (A2 rule).

synthesis.description: Output of the dashboard_spec's synthesis_prompts. Iter-1 ships a minimal synthesis (headline + caveats_summary); deeper synthesis is iter-2.

claim_vectors.description: Per-sub-skill VERDICT-INERT signal decomposition + canonical headline, keyed by sub-skill short name. Carried from each sub-skill's _synthesis_facet by the target-profile fan-out; ABSENT for compose-dashboard packages. Additive — the synthesis block intentionally does NOT set additionalProperties:false (sub_verdicts / recommendation_gate ride as consumer-owned additional properties).

claim_vector.description: The {axis: {signal, corroboration, evidence, conflict, informs, evidence_atom?}} projection (claim_vector_core), plus a `_disclaimer` string. Each axis object stays open (signal/corroboration/... ride freely); the ONLY structural pin is that a present `evidence_atom` must be a well-formed citable atom (see $defs.evidence_atom) — the citation-integrity guard.

renderings.description: References to rendered surfaces produced for this package. Iter-1 ships markdown only.

subtype_resolved.description: OPTIONAL first-class subtype-resolved EVIDENCE block (subtype-first-class-evidence-axis spec, Option A). Present only for runs scoped to molecular strata (target-profile `--subtypes`); ABSENT for default (no-strata) runs, which stay byte-stable. This block makes the per-stratum subtype SIGNALS machine-readable so the cross-evidence integrator can reason at subtype resolution WITHOUT changing the deterministic spine's deliberate 'subtype = context, not a gate' treatment. It is SOFT integrator context: it never raises certainty beyond what a stratum's n supports, never overrides a gate, and a stratum below its n-floor carries no weight. No positive subtype signal here enters any hard gate.

evidence_atom.description: A CITABLE evidence atom on a claim_vector axis (produced by the shared claim_vector_core.build_atom): the load-bearing numeric VALUES bound to their source {card_id, fields}. Structural guard for CITATION INTEGRITY — an atom must carry a `cite.card_id` (a string that resolves to a composed card), so a downstream reasoner can never cite a phantom source. additionalProperties stays open (read/entity ride along).

read.description: Human-readable one-token read of the atom (often the class label).

values.description: The load-bearing values (numeric/label), verbatim from the source card summary.

card_id.description: The source card_id — MUST resolve to a composed card in this package (citation-integrity).

fields.description: The sorted value keys that are citable fields (list-valued keys are omitted here but kept in `values`).

entity.description: Measurement-type / grain identity of the source.

headline_block.description: The canonical per-skill HEADLINE block (verdict + confidence + top tension) produced by headline_core.build_headline — a VERDICT-INERT projection over the sub-skill's claim_vector / key_signals. Carries a deterministic one-sentence headline_text plus a renderer-agnostic `hero` plot_data payload (rendered by headline_hero to figure_headline_hero.{svg,png,json}). It never mints or lifts a verdict; the authoritative call remains the resolver gate verdict.

verdict.description: The canonical, single-spelling verdict for this lens.

level.description: Weakest-link over the claim vector's corroboration (measured axes), capped by conflict and coverage; or the CERTAINTY_MODEL sidecar level when the skill emits one.

top_tension.description: The single highest-severity tension (claim conflict / key-signals caveat / skill-specific), or null when none.

headline_text.description: Deterministic one-sentence headline (NOT the LLM narration).

hero.description: Renderer-agnostic hero plot_data (verdict badge, confidence meter, per-axis signal×corroboration, tension marker).

provenance.description: Citations lifted from the claim_vector atoms: {axis, card_id, fields}.

subtype_resolved.description: Subtype-resolved evidence block (Option A). Carries, per requested molecular stratum, the per-stratum evidence_state / effect-size metric / subgroup_n / n-floor-met drawn from the subtype-grain cards' per_subgroup_metrics (dependency + mutation-frequency today), plus the cross-axis subtype convergence facet. Additive + independently schema-versioned (schema_version inside this block, distinct from the envelope's top-level schema_version). Verdict-inert: nothing here mints or lifts a nomination.

schema_version.description: Version of the subtype_resolved block shape (independent of the envelope's schema_version).

requested_strata.description: The molecular strata the run was scoped to (mirrors context.subgroup_spec when that is a list). Empty when a subtype-scoped run named no resolvable strata.

available_strata.description: Strata that actually appeared in at least one subtype-grain card's per_subgroup_metrics this run. A requested stratum absent here had no per-stratum record (coverage/floor gap) and carries no weight.

per_stratum.description: One record per stratum observed in the subtype-grain cards, each carrying its per-axis evidence_state / n / floor / metric. ABSENCE-DISCIPLINE: a stratum below its n-floor is present but flagged subgroup_n_floor_met=false, so a consumer must not credit it.

convergence_facet.description: The cross-axis subtype convergence facet (_subtype_facet): per-molecular-subtype which axes carry a MEASURED signal, which subtypes converge on >=2 axes (convergent_subtypes), and registry-bridged associations (associated_subtypes). Previously computed but dropped from the package (emitted only to nomination.json); surfaced here for the integrator. Shape is the facet's own; validated loosely.

_disclaimer.description: Human-readable statement of the SOFT/verdict-inert contract for this block.

subtype_stratum_record.description: Per-stratum evidence record: the molecular stratum id + its per-axis per_subgroup_metrics projection.

stratum.description: The molecular-subtype identity (e.g. MSI_H, MSS, NAPY strata).

axes.description: Keyed by evidence axis (dependency, mutation_frequency). Each value is the axis's per-stratum projection.

evidence_state.description: measured / underpowered / absent — the per-stratum evidence state emitted by the subtype-grain card. null when the card row did not carry one.

subgroup_n.description: Number of samples/models in the stratum for this axis.

subgroup_n_floor_met.description: Whether the stratum cleared its per-axis n-floor. false => carries no weight (absence-discipline at stratum grain).

metric.description: The per-stratum effect-size / class the panorama row exposes (e.g. a Chronos median, a mutation frequency). Shape varies per axis; validated loosely.

measurement_type.description: OPTIONAL (2026-08-16, cross-evidence roadmap invariant 8). The card's IDENTITY — the single per-target-entity CLAIM it measures, a key in target-contracts/vocabularies/measurement_types.yaml (e.g. crispr_lof_dependency, tumor_vs_normal_selectivity). Stamped by the emitting skill (resolved from the registry's card back-refs) so a cross-evidence integrator can group cards by claim without re-deriving it from card_id. Additive + backward-compatible; the default byte-golden envelope omits it.

evidence_substrate.description: OPTIONAL (2026-08-16, independence-before-certainty). The shared underlying RAW DATA PRODUCT this card's measurement_type is computed from — a key in measurement_types.yaml's `evidence_substrates` vocab (e.g. recount3_tcga_gtex_bulk_rna, depmap_crispr_chronos). Two present cards sharing an evidence_substrate are NOT independent corroboration: their agreement is a correlated re-read of the SAME measurements (the HTR1D expression<->selectivity double-count), so the integrator must not count them twice toward certainty. Absent = genuinely-independent singleton (the common case). Additive; the default byte-golden envelope omits it.

validation_state.description: Present-card entries are pass or passed_with_warnings. Failed cards do NOT appear in the envelope.

summary.description: The card's emitted summary fields. Shape varies per card_id (matches the card_spec's outputs.summary_fields).

figures.description: Figure descriptors emitted by phase-2's figure-emission registry. Path is relative to the evidence package's output root.

interpretation_call.description: The interpretation label emitted by the card's first-matching interpretation_hints rule. For negative-control runs, expect values like 'not informative' or 'no characterized hotspot landscape'.

warning_ids.description: Structured warning identifiers fired by the card's warning_predicates (when validation_state is passed_with_warnings). Free-text warnings are NOT acceptable; see validation_state.enum.yaml.passed_with_warnings.requires_structured_warning_ids.

required_product_ids.description: OPTIONAL (2026-08-16, cross-evidence roadmap invariant 8). The products.yaml product_ids the card DECLARES as inputs (card_spec.required_inputs[].product_id) — the STABLE, release-independent declared-input identity, coarser than input_manifest_ids (which pins a concrete release). Surfaced so a cross-evidence integrator can detect shared underlying products across cards at the declared-input grain, complementing the coarser evidence_substrate. Additive; the default byte-golden envelope omits it.

canonical_decision_refs.description: References to canonical-decisions records (resolves open item #8). Required for governance-grade packages.

excluded_by_applies_when.description: Discriminator: distinguishes excluded entries from card_present entries.

exclusion_reason.description: Structured reason: the applies_when predicate (or cascading-exclusion link) that failed. NOT free text — must reference the failed predicate.

card_unavailable.description: A card that produced NO usable signal, carrying a typed reason WHY. Replaces the historical silent drop-to-n_cards_failed: an unwired / data-blocked / errored / measured-absent card is a first-class reasoned absence, so a consumer (and the deciding-axis router) can distinguish 'we haven't built it' from 'we looked and it's genuinely unknown'. Discriminator: `availability_state` present (card_present has validation_state; card_excluded has excluded_by_applies_when).

availability_state.description: WHY the card is unavailable. See vocabularies/availability_state.enum.yaml. not_wired/data_blocked/read_error are framework-COVERAGE gaps (never looked / could not look); insufficient is a MEASURED gap (looked, target genuinely absent / below floor). None is opposing evidence.

availability_reason.description: Human-readable, structured reason string (e.g. 'dispatcher_returned_none', 'live_read_error: <detail>', 'primary_class=data_unavailable'). Names the concrete cause; not free-form narrative.
